mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted = 0
SELECT r.role_key FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1

SELECT DISTINCT m.permission FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.permission IS NOT NULL AND m.permission != '' AND m.status = 1

WITH RECURSIVE seeds(id, expand) AS ( SELECT u.dept_id, FALSE FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND r.data_scope = 2 AND u.dept_id IS NOT NULL AND u.deleted = 0 UNION SELECT u.dept_id, TRUE FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND r.data_scope = 3 AND u.dept_id IS NOT NULL AND u.deleted = 0 UNION SELECT rd.dept_id, FALSE FROM sys_role_dept rd INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rd.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.data_scope = 4 UNION SELECT d.id, s.expand FROM sys_dept d INNER JOIN seeds s ON d.parent_id = s.id WHERE s.expand AND d.deleted = 0 ) SELECT DISTINCT id FROM seeds WHERE id IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.data_scope = 1 AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1
